summary.en: Survivors of Venezuela's devastating earthquakes are being cared for at a makeshift hospital formed on the site of a country club in
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A country club in the town of Caraballeda in Venezuela has been turned into a makeshift hospital, with survivors of the country's devastating earthquakes receiving care and sleeping on mattresses on the grass.

Helicopters carrying aid have landed at the improvised hospital and those who lost their homes during the quake are being provided with food, water and clothes.

Caraballeda located in the state of La Guaira, is one of the areas most affected by the earthquakes.
body.zh: 委内瑞拉卡拉巴莱达镇的一个乡村俱乐部被改造成临时医院，该国毁灭性地震的幸存者接受护理并睡在草地上的床垫上。 运送援助物资的直升机已降落在临时医院，正在为在地震中失去家园的人们提供食物、水和衣服。 卡拉巴莱达位于拉瓜伊拉州，是受地震影响最严重的地区之一。

title.en: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
title.zh: 世卫组织称欧洲热浪已致1300人死亡，德国气温创41.7摄氏度新高

summary.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that Europe's recent heatwave has been linked to 1,300 deaths, with Germany recording a record high of 41.7C. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is currently unprepared for such high temperatures.
summary.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）报告称，欧洲最近的热浪已导致1300人死亡，德国气温达到创纪录的41.7摄氏度。世卫组织总干事谭德塞警告说，欧洲尚未为应对如此高温做好准备。

body.en:
Europe's unprecedented early summer heatwave may be responsible for hundreds of excess deaths, according to the head of the World Health Organization (WHO).

Temperature records were broken across the continent again on Sunday – including in Germany, Poland and the Czech Republic – as the extreme heat continued to move east.

In a post on X, WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said more than 1,300 excess deaths had been recorded since 21 June "linked to high temperatures in Europe".

"Heat stress is often called the 'silent killer' - and European homes, workplaces and schools were not built for these temperatures," he said.

On Sunday morning, France's national health ministry said there had been around 1,000 more deaths than expected in the country since Wednesday.

Many of the extra fatalities are among those aged 65 over, the agency said, after logging a 40% rise in the number of people dying at home.

"Europe is the fastest-warming continent on Earth, heating at twice the global average," Tedros warned.

Millions of people across the continent are currently "living under extreme heat, hundreds have died, schools are shut, grids are buckling", he added.

On Sunday, Germany experienced its hottest-ever day for the third consecutive day after 41.7C was recorded in the east of the country, preliminary data showed.

A station in Coschen, near the Polish border in eastern Brandenburg, recorded 41.7C at around 16:00 local time.

The Czech Republic set its second temperature record in two days, recording 41.1C at Doksany, north of Prague, the meteorological institute CHMI said.

CHMI said it expected the heat to peak on Sunday, with rather heavy storms forecast for western areas later.

Poland also broke its all-time temperature record with 40.5C in the town of Slubice, a spokeswoman for the Institute of Meteorology and Water Management (IMGW) told the AFP news agency on Sunday.

Climate change was responsible for the extreme weather, Tedros said, warning that Europe was warming at "twice the global average".

"Driven by climate change and global warming, the phenomenon of the 'once-in-a-generation' heatwave is now occurring nearly annual," he said.

He called on European countries to "implement heat health action plans", as part of a push to safeguard health in the face of climate change.
body.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）负责人表示，欧洲史无前例的初夏热浪可能导致数百人超额死亡。 周日，随着极端高温继续向东移动，包括德国、波兰和捷克共和国在内的整个欧洲大陆的气温记录再次被打破。 世卫组织总干事谭德塞在 X 上发帖称，自 6 月 21 日以来，已有超过 1,300 人死亡，“与欧洲高温有关”。 “热应激通常被称为‘无声杀手’——欧洲的家庭、工作场所和学校并不是为这样的温度而建造的，”他说。 周日上午，法国国家卫生部表示，自周三以来，该国的死亡人数比预期多了约 1,000 人。 该机构表示，在家里死亡的人数增加了 40% 后，新增死亡人数中有许多是 65 岁以上的人。 谭德塞警告说：“欧洲是地球上变暖最快的大陆，升温速度是全球平均水平的两倍。” 他补充说，非洲大陆数百万人目前“生活在酷热之下，数百人死亡，学校关闭，电网崩溃”。 初步数据显示，周日，德国东部地区气温达到 41.7 摄氏度，连续第三天遭遇有史以来最热的一天。 勃兰登堡东部靠近波兰边境的科申（Coschen）的一个气象站在当地时间 16:00 左右记录到 41.7 摄氏度。 气象研究所 CHMI 表示，捷克共和国在两天内创下了第二个气温记录，布拉格北部的多克萨尼 (Doksany) 录得 41.1 摄氏度。 CHMI表示，预计高温将于周日达到顶峰，预计西部地区稍后将出现强风暴。 气象和水管理研究所（IMGW）发言人周日告诉法新社，波兰斯鲁比采镇的气温也打破了历史记录，达到 40.5 摄氏度。 谭德塞表示，气候变化是造成极端天气的原因，他警告说，欧洲的变暖速度“是全球平均水平的两倍”。 他说：“在气候变化和全球变暖的推动下，‘一代一遇’的热浪现象现在几乎每年都会发生。” 他呼吁欧洲国家“实施高温健康行动计划”，作为应对气候变化推动保障健康的一部分。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life during Europe's heatwave underscores the urgent need for foresight and preparedness in the face of environmental challenges. As Proverbs 27:12 reminds us, the prudent anticipate danger and take necessary refuge. This wisdom calls us to proactively adapt and protect vulnerable communities from escalating risks.
reflection.zh: 欧洲热浪中生命的悲剧性逝去，凸显了面对环境挑战时，预见性和准备工作的紧迫性。正如箴言27:12提醒我们的，通达人预见危险就藏躲，愚蒙人却往前行，自受亏损。这种智慧呼吁我们积极适应并保护弱势群体免受日益增长的风险。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Three firefighters die battling huge wildfires on Colorado-Utah border
title.zh: 三名消防员在科罗拉多州和犹他州边境的巨大野火中丧生

summary.en: A number of blazes have been raging across Utah and Colorado, leading both governors to declare states of emergency.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Three firefighters were killed and two were injured while battling massive wildfires on the Colorado-Utah border on Saturday, officials say.

The firefighters were part of a federal response team assigned to the Knowles and Gore fires. They were suddenly overwhelmed by flames and tried to take shelter, the Department of the Interior said.

The two injured firefighters suffered burns and were taken to hospital for treatment.

"Our immediate focus is on supporting their families, friends, and fellow crewmates during this incredibly difficult time," the US Wildland Fire Service said of the firefighters, whose names have not been released.

The Knowles and Gore fires have since spread and merged with other fires to form the Snyder Mesa fire, which as of Saturday had burnt around 28,000 acres of land, Colorado Governor Jared Polis's office said.

The deaths and injuries happened during a "burnover incident", the US Wildland Fire Service said. That is when a fire spreads so suddenly and rapidly that it overtakes personnel or equipment, cutting off escape routes and forcing trapped firefighters to deploy an emergency, last-resort shelter tent.

"The US Wildland Fire Service stands united with the USDA Forest Service in grief and in our unwavering support for the loved ones left behind," the service said. "Their bravery, dedication, and sacrifice will never be forgotten."

The five firefighters were from two federal agencies that oversee the management of public lands, the US Wildland Fire Service and the US Forest Service.

The wildland service, which is part of the US Department of the Interior, was established in January this year to streamline firefighting efforts across public lands.

Governor Polis declared a state of emergency for Colorado on Saturday, authorising the state's National Guard to join the response efforts.

"I'm devastated about the loss of three heroic firefighters who died in the line of duty in Western Colorado," he said in a statement.

"To the loved ones of those lost, and to their fellow crew members - some who are still battling the flames – know that the State of Colorado mourns alongside you," the governor added.

In Utah, the largest of eleven active blazes is the Cottonwood Fire, which as of Sunday covered over 93,000 acres and was 0% contained, according to the US Forest Service. Utah Governor Spencer Cox has also issued an emergency order banning the use of fireworks ahead of the 4 July weekend.

The fires spread across Utah and Colorado are in mostly sparsely-populated areas, but have threatened some resorts and cabins. Warmer winters and high winds have fuelled recent fires across much of the western US.

body.zh: 官员称，周六，在科罗拉多州和犹他州边境扑灭大规模野火时，三名消防员丧生，两人受伤。 这些消防员是负责处理诺尔斯和戈尔火灾的联邦响应小组的成员。内政部表示，他们突然被火焰淹没并试图躲避。 两名受伤消防员被烧伤，被送往医院救治。 美国野地消防局在谈到这些消防员时表示：“我们当前的重点是在这个极其困难的时期为他们的家人、朋友和同事提供支持。”但消防员的姓名尚未公布。 科罗拉多州州长贾里德·波利斯办公室表示，诺尔斯和戈尔大火随后蔓延，并与其他火灾合并形成斯奈德梅萨大火，截至周六，这场大火已烧毁约 28,000 英亩土地。 美国荒地消防局表示，死亡和受伤事件是在一次“烧毁事件”中发生的。当火势突然蔓延、迅速蔓延，以至于淹没人员或设备、切断逃生路线并迫使被困的消防员部署紧急避难帐篷时，这是最后的手段。 该部门表示：“美国荒地消防局与美国农业部林务局团结一致，表达悲痛，并坚定不移地支持留下的亲人。” “他们的勇敢、奉献和牺牲永远不会被忘记。” 这五名消防员来自两个负责监督公共土地管理的联邦机构：美国荒地消防局和美国林业局。 荒地服务局隶属于美国内政部，于今年一月成立，旨在简化公共土地上的消防工作。 周六，波利斯州长宣布科罗拉多州进入紧急状态，授权该州国民警卫队加入应对工作。 他在一份声明中说：“我对在科罗拉多州西部因公殉职的三名英雄消防员的去世感到悲痛。” 州长补充道：“对于那些遇难者的亲人以及他们的船员同胞——其中一些人仍在与大火搏斗——要知道，科罗拉多州与你们一起哀悼。” 在犹他州，Cottonwood 火灾是犹他州 11 场火灾中规模最大的一场，据美国林业局称，截至周日，火灾面积超过 93,000 英亩，控制率为 0%。犹他州州长斯宾塞·考克斯还发布了一项紧急命令，禁止在 7 月 4 日周末之前使用烟花。 蔓延到犹他州和科罗拉多州的大火大多发生在人口稀少的地区，但威胁到了一些度假村和小屋。温暖的冬季和大风加剧了美国西部大部分地区最近的火灾。 科学家们认为，气候变化使得炎热和干旱等天气条件更有可能导致野火。

title.en: ‘Financial pandemic’: £1 in every £11 spent on UK public contractors goes to private equity
title.zh: “金融大流行”：英国公共承包商每11英镑支出中就有1英镑流向私募股权

summary.en: A Guardian analysis reveals that nearly £24.4 billion of UK government funds were allocated to private equity-run firms in the year leading up to April 2025, raising concerns about the impact on public services, including the potential for vulnerable individuals, such as children in care homes, to be treated poorly.
summary.zh: 《卫报》分析显示，截至2025年4月的一年里，英国政府近244亿英镑的资金流向了由私募股权运营的公司，这引发了人们对公共服务影响的担忧，包括弱势群体（如寄养院中的儿童）可能受到不当对待。

body.en: Almost £24.4bn of government money went to private equity-run firms in year to April 2025, Guardian analysis shows ‘Treating children like cattle’: what happens when private equity takes over a UK care home? Nurseries, vets and shops: the sectors where private equity plays a big role One pound in every £11 of UK government spending on contractors went to private equity-controlled companies last year, research shows, including key services such as transport, waste management and healthcare. title.en: French skydiving plane crashes near Nancy, killing all 11 onboard

summary.en: Five students and five instructors dead along with pilot after plane fell suddenly near aerodrome, says prefect A skydiving plane has crashed in north-eastern France, killing all 11 people onboard, according to the region’s prefect. The parachuting-school plane crashed near...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A skydiving plane has crashed in north-eastern France , killing all 11 people onboard, according to the region’s prefect.

The parachuting-school plane crashed near Nancy at 11am, said Yves Séguy, the prefect of the Meurthe-et-Moselle region.

The pilot and 10 passengers – five ‌students and five instructors – died, the prefecture reported.

The students were a group of nurses, according to a source close to the case and confirmed by the head of Meurthe-et-Moselle’s nursing council, Thierry Pechey.

“They were colleagues who had decided to go on a first skydiving jump, no doubt to unwind, as we’re going through a difficult time with the heatwave,” he said.

The plane suffered a malfunction and “fell almost vertically” after taking off from Nancy-Essey airfield on the outskirts of Nancy, Séguy said. “The plane, which was transporting 11 people, fell suddenly immediately next to the aerodrome. There were no collateral victims.”

It crashed on the edge of a built-up area near the airfield, he told the broadcaster BFMTV. “Had it occurred just a few dozen metres away, the accident could have caused collateral casualties,” Séguy added.

The parachutists were to have jumped as tandems, the Nancy mayor, Mathieu Klein, told public broadcaster France Info. In tandem jumps, two people, often an instructor and a first-time skydiver, are attached together for the descent.

Klein said some of those taking part had families and friends who had come to watch and saw the plane fall from the sky.

Emergency services responded immediately and were providing psychological support to several relatives of the victims, Séguy said, adding that authorities were also collecting witness statements.

“We are deploying all available resources,” he said, including emergency medical teams, fire services, police and mental health support.

A resident, identified as John Curaku by BFM-TV, told the broadcaster that he was in his garden when he heard what sounded like a plane’s engine stopping, immediately followed by a bang.

He said he went to the crash site and “there were no signs of life”, with two of the bodies thrown a few metres from the plane.

The French interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, was on his ​way to ​the ​scene, his staff ‌said.
body.zh: 据该地区州长称，一架跳伞飞机在法国东北部坠毁，机上 11 人全部遇难。 默尔特-摩泽尔地区州长伊夫·塞吉 (Yves Séguy) 表示，这架跳伞学校飞机于上午 11 点在南希附近坠毁。 据该县报道，飞行员和 10 名乘客（五名学生和五名教练）死亡。 据知情人士透露，这些学生是一群护士，默尔特-摩泽尔省护理委员会主席蒂埃里·佩奇 (Thierry Pechey) 也证实了这一消息。 “他们是同事，决定进行第一次跳伞，毫无疑问是为了放松，因为我们正在经历热浪的困难时期，”他说。 塞吉说，这架飞机从南希郊区的南希-埃西机场起飞后出现故障，“几乎垂直坠落”。 “这架载有11人的飞机在机场附近突然坠落。没有造成人员伤亡。” 他告诉 BFMTV 广播公司，飞机坠毁在机场附近建筑区的边缘。 “如果事故发生在几十米外，事故可能会造成附带伤亡，”塞吉补充道。 南锡市市长马蒂厄·克莱因 (Mathieu Klein) 告诉公共广播公司“法国信息”，跳伞者将串联跳伞。在双人跳伞中，两个人（通常是教练和初次跳伞运动员）一起下降。 克莱因说，一些参加者的家人和朋友前来观看并看到飞机从天而降。 塞吉说，紧急服务部门立即做出反应，并向几名受害者亲属提供心理支持，并补充说当局还在收集目击者的证词。 “我们正在部署所有可用资源，”他说，包括紧急医疗队、消防队、警察和心理健康支持。 一位被 BFM-TV 确认为约翰·库拉库 (John Curaku) 的居民告诉广播公司，当时他正在自家花园里，听到飞机发动机停止的声音，紧接着传来一声巨响。 他说，他去了坠机现场，“没有生命迹象”，两具尸体被扔到距离飞机几米远的地方。 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯 (Laurent Nuñez) 的工作人员表示，他正在前往现场的路上。

body.en:
Eleven people have died after a civilian aircraft carrying skydivers crashed in the town of Tomblaine in eastern France, local authorities said.

The pilot and 10 passengers died in the incident, including five students and five instructors, according to local officials.

The plane, which was being used by a parachutist school, had taken off from Nancy-Essey airfield when it crashed, local media reported.

Police have urged the public to avoid the area around the airport in the Meurthe-et-Moselle department.

French transport minister Philippe Tabarot said he and interior minister Laurent Nunez were travelling to the scene of the crash, which he called a "terrible tragedy".

Yves Seguy, the prefect of the eastern department of Meurthe-et-Moselle, said that no bystanders were injured in the incident, according to the AFP news agency .

"The plane fell almost vertically, in the immediate vicinity of a housing estate, on the edge of the airfield," Seguy told French broadcaster BFM, adding it was lucky there were no additional victims.

Half of the skydivers who died were nurses, Thierry Pechey, president of the Meurthe-et-Moselle branch of the Order of Independent Nurses, told BFM.

Local officials also said relatives of the victims were present at the airfield when the crash happened. They were reportedly there to watch the dive, which was a first skydiving experience for the five students.

A witness to the crash, who declined to be identified, told Reuters he saw the plane veering off to the right as he was driving past.

The man did not see the crash, due to an embankment by the side of the road, but he says he heard the sound.

When he arrived at the site, he tried to help extinguish the wreckage of the plane, which had caught fire.

"We saw right away that it was over, that they had all died instantly. There was no movement, and it was clear the impact had been too violent for there to be any survivors."

A team of specialists was on its way to investigate the cause of the incident, Meurthe-et-Moselle department president Chaynesse Khirouni told local media.

Fourteen people were killed when a helicopter crashed in Saudi Arabia, state media reported on Sunday.

The helicopter, belonging to state oil giant Aramco, crashed in the eastern coastal city of Ras Tanura at 06:00 local time (03:00 GMT) killing all those on board, according to the Saudi Press Agency.

All 14 victims were Saudi citizens, it reported, with investigations under way to determine the cause of the crash.

Ras Tanura is home to a major Aramco oil refinery - one of the largest in the Middle East.

The Reuters news agency reported that the company had resumed crude oil loading at the site on Friday after an almost four-month pause due to the war in the Middle East.

title.en: Fact check: As Europe bakes, should you trust your sunscreen?

summary.en: As a heat wave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As a heat wave sweeps across Europe, claims are resurfacing online questioning whether sunscreen is safe or linked to skin cancer risk.

Millions of people across Europe are dealing with  temperatures above 40 degrees Celsius  (104 degrees Fahrenheit), baking under a heat dome. Hot nights are making recovery harder.

While many recognize the need to use sunscreen to protect themselves from the sun , some people, particularly on social media, have been asking whether it could actually be harmful.

The discussion centers around the question of whether sunscreen could increase the risk of skin cancer, rather than reduce it.

And while the debate is not new, it does seem to be resurfacing more frequently, as global temperatures continue to rise and droughts and extreme heat become the new normal.

Claim: "According to the National Cancer Institute, since the introduction of sunscreen in 1940, melanoma has increased by over 200%."

This claim, archived here , has appeared on several social media platforms. It further describes sunscreen as a "poison" that prevents the body from properly absorbing sunlight.

First, several studies  have shown that regularly using sunscreen actually reduces the risk of developing melanoma.

"There is no scientific evidence that supports the association of sunscreen use with a higher risk of cancer," said Brittany Schaefer, public information officer with the Connecticut State Department of Public Health.

Schaefer spoke with DW in 2025, when the Fact check team debunked similar claims around sunscreen, especially the false assumption that the countries that use the most sunscreen have the highest incidence of skin cancer.

Second, the US National Cancer Institute  has not said sunscreen use caused a 200% increase in melanoma since 1940.

According to the data, the rate of newly diagnosed melanoma cases has increased by more than 220% from then to 2023.

However, there is no evidence linking the rise in melanoma cases to sunscreen use.

A 2023 study  involving scientists from the US, Germany, Switzerland and Hungary can provide some clues to understand why cases are on the rise.

This final point has also been highlighted by public surveys across several countries, despite recommendations that sunscreen should be used regularly.

In Germany, for example, 51% of respondents said in 2024 that they only use sunscreen in summer or when exposed to direct sunlight, while 17% said they never use it.

And in the United States, a poll conducted in the same year  found that 33% of adults admitted to never using sunscreen at all.

title.en: With 'Operation Purgatory,' Magyar moves to demolish Orban system
title.zh: 马扎尔通过“炼狱行动”拆除欧尔班星系

summary.en: The new Hungarian government is moving swiftly to dismantle the system of former Prime Minister Viktor Orban. The focus: fighting corruption, reforming the media and protecting democracy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The new Hungarian government is moving swiftly to dismantle the system of former Prime Minister Viktor Orban. The focus: fighting corruption, reforming the media and protecting democracy.

Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar  and his government are setting a fast pace of reform.

In his first few weeks in office, Magyar lifted EU blockades introduced by his predecessor, Viktor Orban , and launched a dialogue with Ukraine , which Orban had labeled "The Empire of Evil."

Back home in Budapest, parliament has approved cuts to the salaries of lawmakers and ministers and limited a prime minister's time in office to a maximum of two terms.

Much of this was anti-Orban symbolism. But with these changes under his belt, Magyar has now turned his attention to the substance of his predecessor's regime.

Orban had laid out plans that stretched decades into the future: In the event of his party losing the election, civil servants who would be difficult to replace would sabotage the work of new governments. In addition, billions were squirreled away to continue financing Orban's network.

But thanks to a comfortable two-thirds majority in parliament, the government of Magyar and his Tisza party can now dismantle these structures.

In an address to parliament on Monday, Magyar called Orban's style of rule the "mafia system."  He promised to root it out completely using what he called "Operation Purgatory," a name that likely comes from Magyar's penchant for religious and historical symbols.

Magyar has promised that comprehensive investigations will be done to establish how Orban's family and friends, as well as oligarchs and high-ranking party members, lined their pockets, and vowed that illegally obtained assets will be recovered.

He has also pledged that state institutions, the judiciary and the media will be reformed in such a way that renders it impossible to return to the Orban system, which saw political control of state institutions and the public.

"Orban wanted to tie the hands of the next 10 governments," said the online news outlet 444.hu. "The Magyar administration is now ripping up that plan."

On Tuesday, the parliament passed a first large package of laws relating to "Operation Purgatory."

Most of them were anti-corruption measures. These were key to ensuring that the European Union releases about €17 billion ($19.3 billion) in EU funding for Hungary that was frozen by Brussels because of a perceived risk of corruption during Orban's time in power.

The timing was very important, because a deadline for the payment of one large tranche of these funds, some €10.4 billion, is in August.

title.en: Iran again asserts control over Strait of Hormuz after Trump's Truth Social annihilation threat
title.zh: 特朗普言辞升级，称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，休战协议受考验

summary.en: Iran has fired missiles and drones at US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, leading to an escalation in rhetoric from former President Trump, who stated the "Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist," further testing a fragile truce.
summary.zh: 伊朗向科威特和巴林境内的美国军事基地发射了导弹和无人机，导致前总统特朗普的言辞升级，他声称“伊朗伊斯兰共和国将不复存在”，这进一步考验了脆弱的休战协议。

body.en:
The Iranian foreign minister has warned that any challenge to his country's control of the Strait of Hormuz would increase tensions after a series of tit-for-tat attacks with the United States and social media threats of annihilation from the US president.

During a visit to Iraq on Sunday, Abbas Araghchi said: "Any attempt to adopt new or separate arrangements compared to what is underway by the Islamic Republic of Iran will only lead to more complicated situations and delays in the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and will increase the tensions, as we witnessed in the past two nights."

Araghchi called on all parties to "adhere to the memorandum of understanding and not to allow this MoU to deviate from its course" while proposing a new security framework with Gulf countries.

"We should reach a new framework that includes all countries in the region — and without the presence or interference of any country from outside the region," he said.

The comments came after US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that "the Islamic Republic of Iran will no longer exist" if the US was "forced" to resume the war, accusing Iran of violating the ceasefire.

"There may come a point when we are no longer able to be reasonable, and will be forced to militarily complete the job that we very successfully started," he continued.

The clashes brought new tension to the negotiating process meant to end a war launched by the US and Israel at the end of February.

They also underlined the risks still facing one of the world's most important sea lanes for oil and other commodities.

US Central Command said it had struck 10 Iranian military targets in response to an Iranian drone attack on the Panama-flagged oil tanker Kiku, which was carrying some two million barrels of crude.

The US military said the response targeted "surveillance infrastructure, communication systems, air defense sites, drone storage facilities, and minelayer capabilities".

Iranian media reported several explosions in the Sirik and Qeshm areas of southern Iran.

In retaliation, Iran launched multiple missiles and drones toward neighbouring countries, including Bahrain and Kuwait.

title.zh: 联合国称委内瑞拉地震影响670万人，当地居民恳求更多援助

summary.en: A powerful earthquake in Venezuela has led to a rising death toll of nearly 1,500, with the United Nations reporting that 6.7 million people have been affected. Local residents are urgently appealing for increased humanitarian aid.

body.en:
Close to seven million people may have been impacted by the twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Thursday, leaving nearly 1,500 dead.

The United Nations migration agency estimated on Sunday that "up to 6.76 million people could be affected by the devastating earthquakes".

The International Organization for Migration (IOM) projection highlights the "potentially vast humanitarian impact" of the disaster as locals on the ground claim the government is not responding quickly enough.

Venezuela's interim leader Delcy Rodriguez was booed during a visit to a neighbourhood in the capital Caracas that had been badly affected by the natural disaster.

"The government isn't doing anything for the people," residents yelled on Saturday, many of whom had loved ones trapped under the debris.

As the first US aid flight landed in Caracas, millions of Venezuelans are feared to lack sanitation and other basic needs.

Rodriguez has thanked the international community for the significant outpouring of aid.

However, local residents are being forced to desperately claw away rubble from collapsed apartment buildings.

Experts say the first 72 hours after natural disasters are the key, narrow window for finding the living.

"It's just very chaotic, hot and unorganised," Australian firefighter Craig De Meillon, 43, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency. He travelled alone to La Guaira from Miami to help.

UN aid chief Tom Fletcher on Friday told AFP the death toll could continue to soar.

One runway at Simon Bolivar International Airport is partially functioning for aid landings. A US naval ship has also arrived off the coast.

There was joy in the hardest-hit coastal area of La Guaira, north of Caracas, when locals pulled an infant alive out of the wreckage on Saturday, 32 hours after the initial shocks.

In one social media video, a man welled up in tears as he held the baby in his arms.

title.en: Albania's 'Flamingo Revolution': What's behind the protests?
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚的“火烈鸟革命”：抗议背后的原因是什么？

summary.en: For weeks, crowds of Albanians have been protesting in the streets, asserting they are fighting for democracy. The Prime Minister, Edi Rama, claims the movement is part of a hybrid war.
summary.zh: 数周以来，阿尔巴尼亚民众走上街头抗议的画面传遍全球。抗议者称他们正在为民主而战，而总理埃迪·拉马则坚称这场运动是一场混合战的一部分。

body.en:
For weeks now, images of crowds of Albanians protesting on the streets have been relayed around the world. The protesters say they are fighting for democracy. PM Edi Rama insists the movement is part of a hybrid war.

Every evening at 7 p.m., protesters return to the same square in the Albanian capital, Tirana, with the same symbols, making the same demands.

More than three weeks of uninterrupted daily demonstrations have turned the "Flamingo Revolution" into Albania's largest civic protest movement since the fall of communism.

It began when a government-approved luxury tourism project in Zvernec, a protected coastal area in southern Albania , triggered protests that soon evolved into a broader political movement.

Initially driven by environmental concerns, the demonstrations have expanded into broader demands, including calls for the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama .

Rama has rejected the idea that the unrest can be explained by domestic political grievances alone. Instead, he has argued that protests are unfolding within what he describes as a "hybrid war" driven by external influences and digital manipulation.

For Rama, the controversy gained international visibility only after it became associated with Jared Kushner, the son-in-law of US President Donald Trump , who is planning to build a luxury tourism project in Zvernec.

"The world did not wake up because of the fate of Narta, but because of the name of Jared Kushner," Rama said at a meeting of the Socialist Party's parliamentary group on June 20.

The prime minister has argued that what he referred to as the "digital cyclone" has allowed the protests to be amplified by a broad constellation of external actors, including Trump opponents, anti-Israel groups and what he calls state-sponsored "digital mercenaries."

"State-sponsored actors have been identified, including those from Iran ," he said.

Jonila Godole, scholar of political communication and collective memory at the University of Tirana, said Rama's interpretation of the protests reflects a familiar communications strategy: shifting the focus from the protesters' demands to the alleged forces behind them.

"When a civic protest is presented as Iranian, anti-Israeli or driven by Trump's opponents, attention shifts away from what protesters are demanding. The debate moves instead to the alleged authors of the protest — the external enemy," she told DW.

Godole also sees echoes of Albania's communist past in Rama's rhetoric. During Albania's communist period , political dissent was routinely portrayed as the work of hostile foreign forces.

She argued that the language of external enemies continues to resurface whenever those in power face sustained domestic pressure.

title.en: Socceroos knockout opponent confirmed after dramatic Group G finish
title.zh: G组戏剧性完赛后，澳大利亚队淘汰赛对手已确定

summary.en: Australia's World Cup knockout opponent was only decided in the dying moments of the final Group G matches.

body.en:
Australia will face Egypt in the World Cup Round of 32 after the Pharaohs held on to finish second in Group G following a dramatic final round of matches.

Egypt sealed its place in the knockout rounds on Saturday afternoon (AEST) with a 1-1 draw against Iran, but was denied top spot in Group G after Belgium thrashed New Zealand 5-1 to edge the Pharaohs on goal difference.

That means Australia will face Egypt in the Round of 32 at Arlington, Texas, at 4am AEST next Saturday. The two sides have never met at a World Cup before.

It's still unclear whether Egyptian star player Mohamed Salah will play in the match.

Salah — who became one of the English Premier League's most celebrated players after signing with Liverpool in 2017 — came off in the 57th minute in the Egypt-Iran match and was seen having his left leg bandaged.

"The doctor will write his report when we get back to the hotel and will carry out a second examination. I spoke with Salah and, God willing, the injury doesn't seem serious," Hassan said.

The Group G standings changed several times throughout the simultaneous matches, with Belgium, Iran and Egypt all sitting second in the group at various times.

In their match against Egypt , Iran scored a stoppage-time goal, which was ruled offside by VAR. Had the goal stood, Iran would have finished second and played Australia next Saturday.

They now face an agonising wait to see if they qualify as one of the top eight third-placed teams.

After a 1-5 defeat to Belgium, New Zealand finished last in the group with one point and were eliminated from the tournament.

Former Socceroo Harry Kewell, speaking before the results were announced, told SBS that Belgium and Egypt looked to be the most dangerous of Australia's opponents.

"Once you get through the group stages, which they successfully navigated through, it's all about now.

"This is where you have to play your best football. This is where you have to strike when your chances are low, you've got to be able to be clinical, and hopefully we can do that and progress one step further."

The challenge for the Australian side will be to play their best football with a couple of players out of action.

The Socceroos are down to a 24-player squad after the injured Jacob Italiano and Mathew Leckie left camp for Austria and Melbourne, respectively.

Italiano played against Türkiye and the United States but was injured at training, while Leckie hurt his hamstring in the side's 2-0 defeat to the US.

Australia have played Egypt twice before, winning a President's Cup match on penalties in 1987. They lost a friendly in Cairo 3-0 in 2010.

title.en: Socceroos stop the nation as Australia v Paraguay smashes World Cup viewing records
title.zh: 澳大利亚队对巴拉圭的比赛打破世界杯收视纪录，举国关注

summary.en: Australia's national football team, the Socceroos, drew a record-breaking 4.8 million viewers for their World Cup match against Paraguay, making it a significant national event.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚国家足球队“袋鼠军团”与巴拉圭的世界杯比赛吸引了创纪录的480万观众收看，成为一项重要的全国性盛事。

body.en:
On Friday, records were broken when millions of Australians tuned in to see the Socceroos play their highest-stakes FIFA World Cup 2026 match so far.

Attracting nearly five million viewers, it was the most-watched World Cup match in history on SBS, according to national ratings rankings from Virtual Australia (VOZ).

Thrilled fans clamoured in pubs and live sites across the nation at midday on Friday, skipping work and school to witness Australia qualify for the knockout stage of the tournament with a draw against Paraguay,

After a crushing loss to the USA in their second group match of the tournament last week, Australia needed to either beat or tie with Paraguay to secure its spot in the next stage, the Round of 32.

A total of 4.844 million viewers and a total TV average audience of 3.086 million across linear television and digital streaming watched the Australia v Paraguay match.

It is the second most-watched broadcast in SBS history, behind the Socceroos' World Cup play-off victory against Uruguay in 2006 (3.416 million, national average audience).

The Paraguay-Australia post-match program attracted 2.872 million viewers, and the pre-match program attracted 2.277 million viewers.

Between live matches and pre- and post-match shows, SBS had the top three programs of the day and five of the top ten.

Cumulatively, 13.9 million Australians, or about half the population, have watched some of the matches in the FIFA World Cup tournament.

The Socceroos' next game is at 4am Saturday, 4 July (AEST) in Arlington, Texas, near Dallas, when they will face Egypt.

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Dettol apologises after ‘toxic men’ advert sparks backlash in China
title.zh: 滴露因“有毒男性”广告在中国引发反弹后致歉

summary.en: British hygiene brand Dettol has apologized and withdrawn an advertisement in China that sparked widespread condemnation. The advert, which the company stated was intended to criticize “toxic men,” featured a man seeking a “clean and untouched” woman.
summary.zh: 英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告引发广泛谴责后，已致歉并撤回该广告。滴露公司称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，但其内容却描绘了一名男子寻找“干净纯洁”女性的情节。

body.en: British disinfectant brand withdraws advert about a man’s efforts to find a ‘clean and untouched’ woman The British hygiene brand Dettol has apologised after an advertisement released in China, which it said was intended to criticise “toxic men”, was widely condemned on social media as offensive to women. The five-minute advert for a multipurpose disinfectant, released across many online platforms at the end of May, features a man comparing his girlfriend with his former partner. Learning that his former girlfriend previously lived with someone else, the man likens their relationship to a “secondhand service”. He then tells his friends that he intends to find a “clean and untouched” woman for whom he can be the first sexual partner. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国消毒剂品牌撤回有关男性努力寻找“干净、未受影响”女性的广告英国卫生品牌滴露在中国发布的一则广告道歉，称该广告旨在批评“有毒男性”，该广告在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责，认为该广告冒犯了女性。五月底，多用途消毒剂的五分钟广告在多个在线平台上发布，其中一名男子将他的女朋友与他的前伴侣进行了比较。当得知他的前女友以前与别人住在一起时，该男子将他们的关系比作“二手服务”。然后他告诉他的朋友，他打算找一个“干净、未受污染”的女人作为他的第一个性伴侣。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The controversy surrounding Dettol's advertisement highlights the importance of recognizing the inherent dignity of every individual. When an advert reduces women to an object defined by their perceived “purity” or “untouched” status, it diminishes the profound truth that all people, male and female, are created in the image of Yahweh. This reminds us to...
reflection.zh: 滴露广告引发的争议，凸显了承认每个人固有尊严的重要性。当一个广告将女性贬低为由其所谓的“纯洁”或“未被触碰”状态来定义的客体时，它就削弱了一个深刻的真理：所有的人，无论男女，都是按雅伟的形象被造的。这提醒我们要维护他人的价值，反映出神赋予每个生命的尊贵。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Chinese supercomputer leapfrogs best US machines to be ranked world’s fastest
title.zh: 中国超级计算机超越美国最强机器，位居世界第一

summary.en: China's LineShine supercomputer has been ranked the world's fastest, marking the first time since 2017 that a Chinese machine has topped the global Top500 list, which measures technological prowess.
summary.zh: 中国的LineShine超级计算机被评为全球最快，这是自2017年以来，中国机器首次在衡量全球科技实力的全球超级计算机500强榜单中位居榜首。

body.en: China’s LineShine debuts at number one in Top500 – a list sometimes viewed as a national measure of global tech prowess A supercomputer in China now outranks its US counterparts as the world’s most powerful. It is the first time since 2017 that a Chinese computer has topped a list sometimes viewed as a measure of a nation’s technological prowess. The LineShine computer in Shenzhen displaced top-ranked US computer El Capitan in the Top500 rankings released on Tuesday. It was LineShine’s debut on the list. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国的 LineShine 首次跻身 Top500 排行榜第一名——该榜单有时被视为衡量全球科技实力的国家标准。中国的超级计算机现已超过美国同行，成为世界上最强大的计算机。这是自 2017 年以来中国计算机首次跻身有时被视为衡量一个国家技术实力的榜单榜首。在周二发布的 Top500 排名中，深圳的 LineShine 计算机取代了排名第一的美国计算机 El Capitan。这是 LineShine 首次上榜。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights humanity's remarkable capacity for innovation and the accelerating pace of technological advancement. As knowledge increases, we are reminded to seek Yahweh's wisdom to guide how we use these powerful tools for the good of all.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了人类卓越的创新能力和科技进步的加速步伐。随着知识的增长，我们被提醒要寻求雅伟的智慧，以指导我们如何运用这些强大的工具造福所有人。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Francis Markus obituary
title.zh: 弗朗西斯·马库斯讣告

summary.en: Francis Markus, former BBC Shanghai correspondent, has died at 65 from cancer. Driven by compassion for those he reported on, he dedicated the last two decades of his life to working for humanitarian organizations across Asia.
summary.zh: 前英国广播公司上海记者弗朗西斯·马库斯因癌症去世，享年65岁。出于对他所报道人群的同情，他将生命中最后二十年奉献给亚洲各地的人道主义组织工作。

body.en: My friend the former BBC Shanghai correspondent Francis Markus, who has died aged 65 of cancer, was a talented journalist whose compassion for those he reported on led him to spend the last two decades of his life working for humanitarian organisations throughout Asia. After being posted to Shanghai in 2002, Francis demonstrated not just an unerring news sense, covering protests in Hong Kong and social change in China, but a deep interest in human stories, from the suicide-watchers patrolling one of China’s highest bridges over the Yangtze River, to the lives of those dealing with HIV. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我的朋友、前 BBC 上海记者弗朗西斯·马库斯 (Francis Markus) 因癌症去世，享年 65 岁。他是一位才华横溢的记者，他对报道对象的同情心促使他在生命的最后 20 年里为亚洲各地的人道主义组织工作。 2002年被派往上海后，方济各不仅表现出了准确无误的新闻嗅觉，报道了香港的抗议活动和中国的社会变革，而且对人类故事有着浓厚的兴趣，从在中国最高的长江大桥之一巡逻的自杀观察者，到那些与艾滋病毒打交道的人的生活。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Francis Markus's life exemplifies a profound compassion that moved beyond observation to active service for the vulnerable. His dedication to humanitarian work in Asia reminds us that Yahweh sees and values every act of kindness shown to those in need. Such a life, marked by selfless care, reflects a deep understanding of what it means to truly love our...
reflection.zh: 弗朗西斯·马库斯的一生展现了深刻的同情心，他超越了观察，积极地为弱势群体服务。他在亚洲投身人道主义工作的奉献提醒我们，雅伟看重并珍视对有需要之人所施行的每一份善举。这样以无私关怀为标志的生命，反映了对真正爱邻舍的深刻理解。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Jimmy Lai, a Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher, has been honored by DW. He founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper before being sentenced to 20 years in prison. His son stated that the award signifies that those who advocate for the freedom of others are not alone.
summary.zh: 香港亲民主派出版商黎智英获得德国之声表彰。他在被判处20年监禁前，创办了香港最大的亲民主报纸。他的儿子表示，这个奖项表明那些为他人自由而奋斗的人“从不孤单”。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent more than 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW honored Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award  at the annual Global Media Forum in Bonn, Germany, on Tuesday.

"While we have spoken freely in the defence of independent media, Jimmy, who founded an independent media company because he believed in the rights of the Hong Kong people to receive information, is locked away for those beliefs," Jodie Ginsberg, CEO of the Committee to Protect Journalists, said in a speech honoring Lai.

"The attacks on Apple Daily and its counterparts in Hong Kong presaged the far greater attacks on civil liberties in the years that followed. Jimmy Lai saw this and spoke out. We can honor him today not only by fighting for his freedom, but by defending the freedoms for which he was jailed."

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

summary.en: China is driving the electric vehicle transition but Europe and other countries are catching up fast. EVs are getting cheaper, more efficient and can travel farther than ever.

body.zh: 中国正在推动电动汽车转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。电动汽车变得越来越便宜、效率越来越高，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

This progress reminds us of the prophetic vision that in the end times, knowledge shall increase, enabling new forms of mobility and understanding.

title.en: Australian man charged with murder in Thailand after teenage girl’s body found in suitcase
title.zh: 澳大利亚男子在泰国被控谋杀，此前一名少女的尸体在行李箱中被发现

summary.en: An Australian man, Simon Peter Carman, 46, has been charged with the murder of a teenage girl after her naked body was discovered in a suitcase in Pattaya City, Thailand. Carman has denied the charges against him.
summary.zh: 一名46岁的澳大利亚男子西蒙·彼得·卡曼在泰国芭堤雅市被控谋杀一名少女，此前这名少女的裸体尸体在一个行李箱中被发现。卡曼否认了对他的指控。

body.en:
An Australian man has been charged with the murder of a teenage girl whose naked body was found in a suitcase in Thailand .

Pattaya City police told the Guardian the man, identified as Simon Peter Carman, 46, has denied the charges against him.

In video footage of Carman in custody obtained by the ABC and other media, Carman says what occurred was “out of my control”. Local Thai media have reported the alleged crime began with a disagreement over money.

Carman was arrested at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi airport on Friday evening in connection with the disappearance of Tunchanok Donhomla, 17, in Pattaya on Thailand’s eastern Gulf coast.

After questioning Carman in the early hours of Saturday morning, local police in Pattaya found a naked body in a suitcase near railway tracks, which they identified as Donhomla.

Police said they have laid three charges against Carman of murder, concealing a corpse in an attempt to hide the cause of death, and abduction of a minor over 15 but not yet 18 years of age for indecent purposes.

In videos taken while Carman was in custody he addresses the victim’s family: “I feel bad for what happened to your daughter. It was out of my control.”

“I hope you – I know you’ll be very sad, upset. Same, same me. It shouldn’t happen. I hope you’re OK – I know you’re not – but I hope and tell other girls just to be … careful …” Carman says in the video.

The footage appears to show scratch marks on Carman’s upper arms and neck which he describes as spider bites: “I think it’s a spider; they always get in here.”

CCTV footage, also seen by the Guardian and verified by police, allegedly shows Carman and Donhomla holding hands in a condo lobby while waiting for an elevator shortly after 3.30am on Thursday.

CCTV footage from later Thursday evening – between 9.25pm and 9.48pm – allegedly shows Carman dragging the suitcase out of the building and leaving on a motorbike with it strapped behind him, and between 9.57pm and 10.06pm returning without the suitcase.

The local Thairath news website reported that Carman pleaded not guilty to police, saying that he acted in self defence which resulted in Donhomla’s death.

Thairath reported that a struggle ensued because of a disagreement over the charge for Donhomla’s time.

In Thailand’s criminal code , being convicted for murder can carry the death penalty or between 15 and 20 years’ inprisonment.

The victim’s father, Thongchai Donhomla, 46, said he was struggling to come to terms with the loss, Reuters reported.

“I am deeply saddened. My daughter had ⁠no mother, so whenever she wanted anything, she would find a ​way herself, and she ​always helped me too,” he ​said.

Carman remained in custody at Pattaya City court on Sunday. He will appear in court at a date to be determined.

title.en: NSW to give $34 million boost to shark-spotting drones with hope of eventual AI automation
title.zh: 新南威尔士州将拨款 3400 万澳元用于鲨鱼识别无人机，希望最终实现人工智能自动化

summary.en: Under the expanded monitoring program, 72 beaches will now have a fleet of drones watching over them 365 days a year.

body.en:
A fleet of drones will patrol NSW beaches from dawn to dusk to spot sharks as artificial intelligence is touted as a long-term solution to saving lives.

NSW Premier Chris Minns said his government would invest an extra $34 million in a major scale-up of drone coverage across beaches in Sydney and along the state's coast.

The plan follows a great white shark attack on a woman swimming between the flags at Sydney's popular Coogee Beach on 13 June.

Teacher Leah Stewart, 34, was critically injured and later had her arm amputated following the mauling.

Under the expanded monitoring program, announced on Sunday, 72 beaches — including at least one in every coastal local government area — will benefit from a fleet of drones watching over them 365 days a year.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"No one can promise a shark mitigation program that can guarantee that there will be zero encounters with sharks," Minns told reporters at Cronulla.

"But our plan here is to reduce the risk for swimmers and surfers in NSW beaches by using the latest technology ... so that you get earlier warning if you're in the water that there is a shark in the vicinity."

The program could eventually culminate in the use of autonomous, AI-enabled drones, rather than human-controlled craft.

"When we can roll out automated drones and AI-assisted monitoring, (it) will make a big difference ... because we'll be able to identify and distinguish between different kinds of marine life for the first time."

Beaches with high numbers of water users will be prioritised for the additional monitoring.

The bolstered surveillance will kick off on Wednesday and include year-round coverage of all of Sydney's main beaches.

Some 500,000 drone flights were expected to be logged annually, Surf Life Saving NSW head Steve Pearce said while pointing to a drone being tested overhead.

"This is just one of a fleet of drones ... that will be rolled out, up and down the NSW coastline, that allows our pilots to pilot drones hundreds of kilometres away from where they're actually situated," he said.

Controversial shark nets will be retained at some beaches, but they will be fortified by aerial surveillance.

Humane World for Animals Australia marine biologist Lawrence Chlebeck welcomed the world-leading commitment to drones, which he said were the best way to watch for sharks and reduce the risk of bites.

But he urged the government to scrap shark nets because they entangle other animals and are considered outdated and ineffective by the scientific community.

The nets, which are removed during the winter whale migration season, will be reinstalled in September.

title.en: High-speed rail is a decades-old Australian dream. One factor could finally make it real
title.zh: 高铁是澳大利亚几十年的梦想。一个因素可能最终使其成为现实

summary.en: It's been debated for decades, but some experts say conditions may finally be right for high-speed rail in Australia.

body.en:

Jon Staniland is one of many commuters on the 4.33pm train to Newcastle who has settled in for a long journey home.

Door to door, it can take Staniland up to two hours to travel home from work in Sydney's CBD to Woy Woy on the Central Coast, although the trip can be as short as one hour and 40 minutes if he gets an express train.

When SBS News meets him on a Monday afternoon, Staniland is working on his laptop. His employer allows him to leave the office early — around 3pm — and finish the rest of his work while in transit.

The 51-year-old makes this four-hour return journey twice a week, but Staniland says he wouldn't have it any other way. He has lived in Woy Woy for 10 years and loves the lifestyle.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Staniland is one of the growing number of Australians choosing to live in regional areas for lifestyle and cost of living reasons, while maintaining jobs in the capital cities.

He's also among the commuters who stand to benefit from a proposed high-speed rail line between Newcastle and Sydney, a project described as a once-in-a-century opportunity to reshape Australia and redefine how people live, work and travel.

The project has progressed to a two-year development phase following the release of a partially redacted business case by the High Speed Rail Authority in February.

The new rail line would slash travel times from Sydney to the Central Coast to around 30 minutes, while the journey to Newcastle would take less than an hour — compared with about two and a half hours by train today.

It would also allow passengers to travel from Newcastle to the new airport in Western Sydney in about 90 minutes.

The federal government announced the start of a two-year development phase in March. Last week, expressions of interest closed for the design and construction of the rail line between the Central Coast township of Ourimbah and Central Station in Sydney's CBD.

In an opinion piece published on 4 March, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said: "The time has come for high-speed rail in Australia — for the good of Australians and, as the business case now shows, for the good of the economy."

While the project still faces significant engineering, funding and political challenges, some experts believe this is the closest Australia has come to getting a high-speed rail project off the ground, and the timing may finally be right.

The idea of high-speed rail excites many Australians, but previous plans have often been stymied by the high costs required.

title.en: Luka's healthy eating became an obsession. Her mum Suze blames 'thinfluencers'

summary.en: A new generation of influencers is promoting extreme thinness to millions online, leading to often-tragic consequences for vulnerable individuals.
summary.zh: 新一代网红正在网上向数百万人宣传极度瘦身，这给脆弱的个体带来了往往是悲剧性的后果。

body.en:
A new generation of influencers is promoting extreme thinness to millions online. Dateline investigates the growing trend and meets the families taking on Big Tech. Watch Under the Thinfluence on Tuesday 30 June at 9.30pm (AEST) on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Content warning: This article contains references to body image and eating disorders.

For Luka and her family, Christmases and special events like birthdays are fraught.

Every year, Luka wants her mum to make her a birthday cake, even though she knows she'll never eat it.

The 23-year-old from Hervey Bay in southern Queensland has lived with anorexia nervosa — one of Australia's deadliest mental illnesses — for nearly a decade. She's been in treatment for six years and is now in recovery.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I had nurses checking on me in the night because I was at risk of my bones protruding through my skin," Luka tells Dateline.

It's a far cry from the little girl she once was — fascinated with healthy eating and nutritious recipes she found on social media. 

"I remember seeing people's exercise routines, their diets and what they ate. And I don't think I was, as a nine-year-old, actively looking for that stuff; I think that's what came up."

When Luka was scouted to become a model at age 13, her interest in her appearance grew; she wanted to look like the models she saw on social media.

Her mother Suze watched in dismay at the constant information Luka was exposed to.

"Whether it's fasting, whether it's eating eight small meals a day, whether it's eating this many grams of protein ... you just get bombarded," she says.

Over time, Luka's interest in healthy eating became an obsession, and she became ill.

"Every birthday, every Easter, we've got all these other alternative Easter presents for Luka that aren't related to food because I didn't want her to miss out," Suze says.

"It's like eating disorder Olympics. You strive for that one goal. To be the thinnest, to be the most in control, to be the sickest, to be suffering the most, to be the most underweight.

For some online content creators, thinness means rising in the ranks on social media.

Popular videos that include commentary on 'What I eat in a day' have become so common that they've been shortened to 'WIEIAD' — typically featuring clean and whole foods, aesthetically plated and presented.

A growing number of social media accounts have built their brand around thinness, weaving it into fitness content, fashion and 'wellness' posts. Known as 'thinfluencers', these influencers centre their content on the pursuit of being thin.

title.en: Fourth positive bird flu case confirmed amid surge of calls to animal disease hotline
title.zh: 第四例禽流感病例确诊，动物疾病热线接报量激增

summary.en: Officials have confirmed a fourth case of bird flu, leading to over four hundred reports to the emergency animal hotline in just over a week.
summary.zh: 官员已确认第四例禽流感病例，导致在一周多时间内，紧急动物热线接到超过四百个报告。

body.en:
Western Australia has confirmed its third positive bird flu case, the fourth recorded in Australia in one week.

The deadly H5 strain of avian influenza was found in a giant petrel discovered in Quindalup, on the state's south-west coast, and confirmed by the CSIRO's Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness on Saturday morning.

There have been four positive cases of H5 bird flu in Australia since 20 June, when the federal government confirmed that two migratory seabirds suspected to be infected with the virus returned positive results.

These first two cases, a brown skua and a giant petrel, were found in the remote Cape Le Grand area, east of Esperance.

The government said on Saturday that the results of a fifth possible positive case, in another giant petrel found west of Esperance, were pending.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the week since reports first emerged of a suspected H5 influenza case on 19 June, Western Australians have made more than 400 reports to the Emergency Animal Disease hotline.

Of these reports, 53 have been prioritised for further investigation by the Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development.

Across the state, 17 negative results have been recorded in the Esperance area, Mid West, Great Southern, South West, Peel and the Perth metropolitan area.

Australia was the last continent to record cases of the highly contagious and deadly strain of bird flu.

So far, three of four confirmed cases were in migratory seabirds found in Western Australia.

South Australia also detected a case in a giant petrel found in the Fleurieu Peninsula on 14 June.

Australia's chief veterinary officer, Dr Beth Cookson, said on Saturday that there was so far no indication the disease had spread to domesticated animals.

"At this stage, there have only been detections in vagrant migratory seabirds that occasionally visit southern Australia," Cookson said.

"There remains no evidence of any mass mortality events and there are no detections in poultry or in our agricultural production system.

Cookson said genomic sequencing indicated that the virus infecting the first confirmed wild bird case in Australia was related to an outbreak on the Heard and McDonald Islands, about 4,100km south-west of Perth.

A recent study found the disease killed 13,000 elephant seal pups on the sub-Antarctic islands, which are Australian external territories.

The arrival of H5 bird flu in Australia prompted grave concerns from scientists over its potential to devastate native wildlife and domesticated bird species.

In both poultry and wild birds, H5 viruses can spread rapidly and cause severe disease, neurological defects, and sudden death....
body.zh: 西澳大利亚州确认了第三例禽流感阳性病例，这是澳大利亚一周内记录的第四例。 在该州西南海岸昆达卢普发现的一只巨型海燕身上发现了致命的 H5 禽流感病毒，并于周六上午得到了 CSIRO 澳大利亚疾病预防中心的证实。 自6月20日联邦政府确认两只疑似感染该病毒的候鸟海鸟返回阳性结果以来，澳大利亚已出现四例H5禽流感阳性病例。 前两个病例是一只棕色贼鸥和一只巨型海燕，是在埃斯佩兰斯以东偏远的勒格兰德角地区发现的。 政府周六表示，第五例可能呈阳性的病例（在埃斯佩兰斯以西发现的另一只巨型海燕）的结果仍在等待中。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自 6 月 19 日首次报告疑似 H5 流感病例以来的一周内，西澳大利亚人已向动物疾病紧急热线报告了 400 多份报告。 在这些报告中，第一产业和区域发展部已优先对 53 份报告进行进一步调查。 全州范围内，埃斯佩兰斯地区、中西部、大南部、西南、皮尔和珀斯大都市区已录得 17 例阴性结果。 澳大利亚是最后一个记录高度传染性和致命性禽流感病例的大陆。 到目前为止，四分之三的确诊病例是在西澳大利亚发现的候鸟海鸟中。 6 月 14 日，南澳大利亚州在弗勒里厄半岛发现的一只巨型海燕中也发现了病例。 澳大利亚首席兽医官贝丝·库克森博士周六表示，到目前为止，没有迹象表明这种疾病已传播给家养动物。 库克森说：“现阶段，仅检测到偶尔访问澳大利亚南部的流浪迁徙海鸟。” “目前还没有任何大规模死亡事件的证据，在家禽或我们的农业生产系统中也没有检测到任何病毒。 库克森说，基因组测序表明，感染澳大利亚首例确诊野鸟病例的病毒与珀斯西南约4100公里处的赫德岛和麦克唐纳岛的疫情有关。 最近的一项研究发现，这种疾病导致亚南极岛屿（澳大利亚的外部领土）上的 13,000 只象海豹幼崽死亡。 H5 禽流感在澳大利亚的到来引起了科学家的严重担忧，担心它有可能破坏本土野生动物和驯养鸟类。 在家禽和野鸟中，H5 病毒可以迅速传播并导致严重疾病、神经缺陷和猝死……

reflection.en: The rapid spread of bird flu among animals reminds us that creation itself groans under the weight of brokenness, awaiting full redemption. Our vigilance in reporting and responding to such outbreaks reflects a compassionate concern for the well-being of all life. Yahweh hears the cries of creation and calls us to be attentive stewards.
reflection.zh: 禽流感在动物中迅速传播，提醒我们受造界本身在破碎的重压下叹息，等候完全的救赎。我们警惕地报告并应对此类疫情，反映了对所有生命福祉的怜悯关怀。雅伟垂听受造界的呼声，并呼召我们作警醒的管家。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Socceroos stop the nation as Australia v Paraguay smashes World Cup viewing records
title.zh: 澳大利亚队对巴拉圭的比赛打破世界杯收视纪录，举国关注

summary.en: Australia's national football team, the Socceroos, drew a record-breaking 4.8 million viewers for their World Cup match against Paraguay, making it a significant national event.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚国家足球队“袋鼠军团”与巴拉圭的世界杯比赛吸引了创纪录的480万观众收看，成为一项重要的全国性盛事。

body.en:
On Friday, records were broken when millions of Australians tuned in to see the Socceroos play their highest-stakes FIFA World Cup 2026 match so far.

Attracting nearly five million viewers, it was the most-watched World Cup match in history on SBS, according to national ratings rankings from Virtual Australia (VOZ).

Thrilled fans clamoured in pubs and live sites across the nation at midday on Friday, skipping work and school to witness Australia qualify for the knockout stage of the tournament with a draw against Paraguay,

After a crushing loss to the USA in their second group match of the tournament last week, Australia needed to either beat or tie with Paraguay to secure its spot in the next stage, the Round of 32.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A total of 4.844 million viewers and a total TV average audience of 3.086 million across linear television and digital streaming watched the Australia v Paraguay match.

It is the second most-watched broadcast in SBS history, behind the Socceroos' World Cup play-off victory against Uruguay in 2006 (3.416 million, national average audience).

The Paraguay-Australia post-match program attracted 2.872 million viewers, and the pre-match program attracted 2.277 million viewers.

Between live matches and pre- and post-match shows, SBS had the top three programs of the day and five of the top ten.

Cumulatively, 13.9 million Australians, or about half the population, have watched some of the matches in the FIFA World Cup tournament.

The Socceroos' next game is at 4am Saturday, 4 July (AEST) in Arlington, Texas, near Dallas, when they will face Egypt.

body.zh: 周五，数以百万计的澳大利亚人收看澳大利亚队进行迄今为止风险最高的 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯比赛，这一纪录被打破。 根据 Virtual Australia (VOZ) 的全国收视率排名，这场比赛吸引了近 500 万观众，是 SBS 历史上收视率最高的世界杯比赛。 周五中午，兴奋的球迷们在全国各地的酒吧和现场欢呼雀跃，翘班翘课，见证澳大利亚队与巴拉圭队战平，晋级世界杯淘汰赛阶段， 继上周小组赛第二场惨败给美国队之后，澳大利亚需要击败或打平巴拉圭才能确保进入下一阶段32强赛。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 共有 484.4 万观众观看了澳大利亚对阵巴拉圭的比赛，线性电视和数字流媒体的电视平均观众总数为 308.6 万。 这是SBS历史上收视率第二高的节目，仅次于2006年澳大利亚队在世界杯附加赛中战胜乌拉圭的比赛（全国平均收视率341.6万人）。 巴拉圭对澳大利亚赛后节目吸引了287.2万人次观看，赛前节目吸引了227.7万人次观看。 在现场比赛和赛前赛后节目中，SBS 拥有当天排名前三的节目以及前十名中的五个节目。 累计有 1,390 万澳大利亚人（约占总人口的一半）观看了 FIFA 世界杯的部分比赛。 澳大利亚队的下一场比赛将于 7 月 4 日（澳大利亚东部时间）星期六凌晨 4 点在达拉斯附近的德克萨斯州阿灵顿举行，届时他们将对阵埃及。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: A national sporting event can unite millions in shared excitement, offering a glimpse of collective passion and the pursuit of a common goal. While the cheers and records of such moments are thrilling, Yahweh reminds us to also seek the imperishable crown of eternal values. This perspective helps us appreciate temporary joys while anchoring our deepest...
reflection.zh: 一场全国性的体育赛事能让数百万人团结在共同的兴奋之中，展现出集体的热情和对共同目标的追求。虽然这些时刻的欢呼和纪录令人激动，但雅伟提醒我们也要寻求那永不朽坏的、永恒价值的冠冕。这种视角帮助我们欣赏暂时的喜乐，同时将我们最深的盼望根植于真正持久的事物。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。
